Riverview Elementary School
5th Grade
Riverview, FL
Plant the Moon Challenge
What soil additive is best for growing 
arugula in lunar regolith?
1. Hypothesis:
Our team believes pot 2 will grow the tallest arugula because the lunar 
regolith is a fine, powdery substance so the fertilized potting mix will 
help provide the essential nutrients arugula needs to grow .
2. Independent Variables:
•
50% lunar simulant / 50% organic potting 
mix
•
50% lunar simulant / 50% fertilized potting 
mix
•
50% lunar simulant / 50% black Kow 
Organic Cow Manure
3. Dependent Variables:
•
Arugula growth
October 14 growth

October 27 growth
How tall with our arugula grow?

Controls:
•
100% organic potting mix
•
100% fertilized potting mix
•
100% black Kow Organic Cow Manure
•
Arugula seeds
•
20 ml tap water
Results: Our hypothesis was that Pot 2 would grow the best because we thought the fertilized potting mix will help 
provide the essential nutrients since the lunar regolith is a fine powdery substance with not many nutrients for plant life. 
However, that was not the case as our pot 2 started to show signs of dying off around the beginning of November in the 
fifth week of growing. It was pot 3 with the organic potting mix that proved to be the most successful. Pot 4 grew along 
in the middle of the cup but didn't ever sprout up through the top of the layer of soil and lunar regolith. Our pots 
persevered through two hurricanes breaks and our grow period would have ended on November 21 but since we had 
that week off from school, we recorded the data on Friday November 18 and then again after our break on November 
28. The week off school in which our classroom blinds were closed allowing minimal amount of light for the plants 
along with no water had detrimental effects on the final data collection. One important piece we learned was that the 
organic potting soil proved to grow our arugula more successfully than the fertilized potting soil and the black Kow 
manure brand.
